newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Coordinators call 2.5 pct option in MOL.
newsitem.headline: Coordinators call 2.5 pct option in MOL.

text.p: The global coordinators of Hungarian oil and gas company MOL's private placement called an overallotment option for 2.5 percent of the company's shares, the Hungarian news agency MTI said on Wednesday.
The global coordinators were Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, Salomon Brothers International and Hungary's Creditanstalt Ertekpapir Rt, MTI said, quoting the state privatisation agency APV.
APV had placed 12.5 percent of MOL with international investors earlier this month and also sold four percent to domestic investors via a public offering.
APV sold altogether 19 percent of MOL this month, and MTI said that the agency retained a 39.7 percent stake.
MOL closed on the Budapest Stock Exchange at 3,300 forints on Thursday, down 80 forints.
